link.description: Link this Discord account with the code from the platform

code.description: The code from the Connections page, for example ABCD-EFGH

unlink.description: Remove the link between this Discord account and the platform

status.description: Show the link and whether runs are switched on

language.description: Choose the language of the bot's replies

help.description: Show what the bot can do

ask.description: Ask the Chief of Staff or one of your workflows

agent.description: The name of one of your workflows (optional)

cancel.description: Cancel your latest run started from Discord

replies.help:
Commands in this direct message:
/link code: link this Discord account with the code from the Connections page on the platform.
/unlink: remove the link.
/status: show the link, whether runs are switched on, and your runs from Discord.
/language: choose the language of these replies.
/ask text: ask the Chief of Staff. Add agent (or start the text with @name) to ask one of your workflows. Runs from Discord can only read, never change anything.
/cancel: cancel your latest run from Discord.
replies.notAvailable: The chat channel is not available right now.
replies.useDirectMessage: Use these commands in a direct message with the bot.
replies.unknownCommand: Unknown command. Use /help to see the commands.
replies.error: Something went wrong. Try again later.
replies.linkFirst: This Discord account is not linked. Make a code on the Connections page on the platform, then use /link here.
replies.notEntitled: This account cannot use the chat channel.

link.claimed: Code accepted. Go back to the Connections page on the platform and press Confirm to finish linking.
link.invalid: That code did not work. Make a new code on the Connections page and try again.
link.alreadyLinked: This Discord account is already linked. Use /unlink first to link it to another account.
link.paused: Linking is paused for now. Try again later.

unlink.done: The link is removed. This Discord account no longer receives anything from the platform.

status.runCounts:
Runs from Discord in progress: {{running}}.
Steps waiting for your approval: {{waiting}}.

ask.runsOff: Runs are switched off on the platform. Nothing was started.
ask.started: Started. The answer comes here in a direct message when it is ready. You can also follow the run on the Team page.
ask.badTask: Write your question or task in the text option (at most 8000 characters). Nothing was started.
ask.unknownAgent: None of your workflows has that name. Your switched-on workflows: {{names}}. Nothing was started.
ask.ambiguousAgent: More than one of your workflows has that name. Rename one on the platform and try again. Your switched-on workflows: {{names}}. Nothing was started.
ask.noAgents: You have no switched-on workflow with that name. Leave out the agent to ask the Chief of Staff. Nothing was started.
ask.tooMany: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again. Nothing was started.
ask.tooManyRuns: You already have 3 runs from Discord in progress. Wait for one to finish or use /cancel. Nothing was started.
ask.providerOff: The AI provider is switched off on the platform. The run was cancelled before it ran.
ask.noCredits: Your credit balance is too low for this run. The run was cancelled before it ran.
ask.overCap: A daily limit is reached. Try again tomorrow. The run was cancelled before it ran.
ask.workflowOff: That workflow is switched off. Switch it on on the platform first. Nothing was run.
ask.workflowNotTested: Run a test of this version of the workflow on the platform first. Nothing was run.
ask.workflowInvalid: That workflow cannot run from Discord as saved (runs from Discord can only read). Nothing was run.
ask.workflowBudget: The credit budget of that workflow is used up. Nothing was run.
ask.refused: The platform refused this run. Nothing was run. Try it on the Team page to see why.

cancel.done: Your latest run from Discord is cancelled.
cancel.nothing: You have no run from Discord in progress.

result.cut: Cut here: read the rest on the Results page.
result.noAnswer: Your run finished without an answer. See the Results page.
result.failed: Your run failed. See the Results page for details.
result.timedOut: Your run timed out. See the Results page for details.
result.waitingApproval: A step of your run is waiting for your approval on the Team page.

approval.request: Step {{step}} of your run ({{agent}}) is waiting for your approval. It can only read, never change anything. The request:
approval.approved: Approved: step {{step}} ({{agent}}). It is running; the answer comes here when the run is done.
approval.rejected: Rejected: step {{step}} ({{agent}}). Its work will not be used.
approval.unavailable: This button no longer works: the step was decided, the button expired, or the link changed. See the Team page.
approval.notReadOnly: This step is not read-only, so it cannot be approved from Discord. Decide it on the Team page.
approval.testsBlocked: The tests for this step have not passed. Decide it on the Team page.
approval.runsOff: Runs are switched off on the platform. The step was not approved and is still waiting.
approval.providerOff: The AI provider is switched off on the platform. The step was not approved and is still waiting.
approval.noCredits: Your credit balance is too low for this step. The step was not approved and is still waiting.
approval.overCap: A daily limit is reached. The step was not approved and is still waiting.
approval.workflow: The workflow cannot run this step now. The step was not approved; see the Team page.
approval.refused: The platform did not approve this step. It is still waiting; see the Team page for why.
